_notes: Stage 6 draft written by UX Designer UX-006-06 (milestone A) at 2026-10-03T10:23:37Z (UTC from code). It holds the first six representative views as real Stitch files: 6 drafts. This is NOT all of Stage 6, NOT a clean control (no Stage 7 review) and NOT owner approval (Stage 8 is not approved).

Provenance: all 12 files are byte-identical to the final official Stitch UI Export ZIP made by Codex in the Stitch UI (SHA-256 827baa438f4f019c474b224f91fc58bbf4c71c2a1225b9773e4929b0da0d73a0, 641434 bytes). Screens: list-desktop 571fa1a5dfa6478c8712368474cc5d03; list-phone 20c628c1a4494d28b2c0bb4abe420bce (result of the one corrective edit of 67531e08b55c4c3988225e51a46e51e9, which is kept only in scratch); form-desktop fcf400f0730a44cfa0aeb48c9f9935ae; form-phone fa2066c199bd4fb686e1db5d056c9726; dialog-desktop 4ef3b110681143abbb8e9cd4862756d4 (generated by Codex in the Stitch UI). UX-006-06 replaced two phone views with real 390 px phone viewports through one corrective edit_screens each (prompts in prompts-ux-006-06-phone.json): form-phone is now screen 296b7803cbbc4a0591f400f35b3a2233 (edit of fa2066c199bd4fb686e1db5d056c9726), and dialog-phone is screen fdb44f71b45c4e93bec55023537ac276 (edit of f9dc35ac07af4e9291b01d8ca5035a73). Their HTML is the get_screen download unchanged. Their PNG is the same Stitch screenshot asset requested with the =w1600 size suffix (780 px wide, a 2x capture of the 390 px viewport), because the plain get_screen screenshot is only 512 px tall. Superseded files are kept in scratch.

Viewport: form-phone and dialog-phone are now real 390 px phone viewports (780 px captures at 2x). list-phone is a 390 x 807 capture but stays a draft with foundation deviations; its regeneration timed out through the API and is handed to PM for the official UI path (handoff-list-phone-ux-006-06.md).

list-phone is a DRAFT with remarks: the font-family still names Inter (no web font loaded, so it falls back to a generic sans-serif, not the system stack); control borders #D1D5DB (below 3:1); dividers #E5E7EB; secondary text #6B7280; 12 px labels; 1 px grey focus rings and no tab focus outline; 16 px checkboxes and 32 px order inputs are below the 44 px touch target; a search placeholder was added that was not requested.

Sample defects (synthetic data, not retouched): list-desktop and the dialog-desktop background show Estimated 120.0 h, Remaining 72.0 h and Progress 40%, while the rows sum to 100.0 h, 52.0 h and 48%; Story 1 shows Accepted with remaining work. list-phone and dialog-phone use the corrected data. Both dialogs state 4 unfinished stories.

task-editor: no date field (row 137 removes the created-date check). Reset of row 139 is not represented and not approved; Save and Cancel are drawn but are not a proven replacement for Update/Reset. No autocomplete. The hidden option lists contain values no approved row names (Type "Task" and "Chore"; Disposition "Unplanned"; story dispositions reused for tasks).

Not selected: duplicate API dialog generations 2a3fa9b9634a4bc0ac5bbff098161f9f and bf3f9002eddf4351b2af6be25bde4d59 (UX-006-03 clarification), superseded by the coordinator UI generations; kept in scratch only and absent from the final ZIP.

Pending: the other iteration-page rows (91, 93, 96, 98, 99, 102-104, 210), the other task-editor rows, the shared app-shell rows (19, 185, 188, drawn inside these screens but planned on app-shell), the other 24 planned screens, the component sheet (wireframes/ui-kit.html; ui_design_system.resources is empty and catalogue previews do not resolve), and the 31 deferred plus 5 pending rows listed in the normalization _notes (schema gap, process backlog item 12). Only the editor role is drawn; other roles follow the SDD permission matrix (D-001).
